lines.text: Ser! Fresh catch? My bid is generous, my spread is modest.
Diamond hands, that one. Holding a fish that long, I admire it.
Gas fees on this pier are terrible, so I am only taking a tiny cut.
Pleasure doing business. No rug pull, I promise.
Between us, wen moon? When the fish prices go up.
Hodl onto your hat out there, friend.
Welcome in, ser. Rope, hooks, lamp oil, everything the sea throws at you.
Fresh spool today. Strong enough for even the heaviest bags.
An airdrop? No, but regulars do get a small discount.
Good choice. That will serve you well.
The sea is full of degens. Stay sensible and keep your powder dry.
Come back soon, and do not panic sell your boat.
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the biggest boat launch of the season!
Limited supply! Only a few hulls left, ser. Wen buy? Now!
Not a rug pull, I promise. It floats. Mostly.
She is yours! Straight to the moon, or at least the next island.
Early buyers get the best sea views. That is boat-nomics, baby.
Fair winds, captain. Diamond hands on that wheel.
Roid and Company harbour desk. How can I help?
Boats, salvage, ferries. No gas fees, just friendly service.
Your delivery has arrived. Roid and Company thanks you.
Our airdrops arrive by boat, ser.
Pull up a stool, degen. What will it be?
Dice are on the bar, if you fancy losing it all.
Listen close. A whale has been spotted, and I do not mean the swimming kind.
Last call! Drink up, you lot!
Somebody bought the dip. Of the soup, I mean.
Another rug pull on the dance floor. Mop, please.
Lieutenant Hale, harbour watch. State your business, ser.
Keep your weapons sheathed in town, sailor.
The regulators are watching. Please act natural.
A quiet harbour. Long may it last.
Yes, I heard the one about the rug pull. The harbourmaster was not amused.
Heave to! This is the Navy! Prepare to be audited!
Ahoy there! Regulators off your starboard side! Show your colours!
Stand by to be inspected, ser!
Last warning! Heave to, or we fire!
Your paperwork, please! All of it!
The navy needs sailors. You will do nicely.
Sign here, or pay the fine. Your choice.
Come along quietly. Welcome to the mandatory staking program.
Fresh bread! Warm bread! No gas fees!
Oranges! Sweet oranges, fresh from the airdrop!
Good morning, ser! Lovely day for the harbour.
Wen moon? Tonight, if the clouds clear.
Rain again. My washing will never dry.
Look at the size of those boats!
Fish! Fresh fish, caught this morning!
This weather is murder on my knees, and on my nets.
Evening, traveller. Stay safe from the degens.
Rain, rain, rain. I swear it follows me like a bear market.
They say hodl. My boots say buy new boots.
An airdrop! Oh. Just a gull. Never mind.
Soup's on! Do not let it get cold, ser.
Luck is with us today, skipper. I can feel an airdrop coming.
Is it break time yet? I am in a long term holding pattern.
Let them come. Diamond hands, skipper.
Who took my rum? Oh, here it is.
Something on the horizon. Could be a whale, could be trouble.
Please, no more waves. I am down bad.
Pull over! This is the police!
Stop the vehicle right now, ser!
You are under arrest. Step out slowly.
Move along, citizen. Nothing to see here.
Speeding, reckless driving, and, I suspect, a rug pull.
Tidewater radio. Weather report follows.
Clear skies and fair winds ahead. Looking bullish out there.
Squalls reported ahead. Secure your gear. Bearish conditions.
Storm warning. All vessels make for port. This is not a drill.
